S&P affirms A- rating; reflects strong enterprise position post-Covia merger; >$400M revenue.

Major member SNFs in CA: St Paul's Towers Oakland (CCN 055156, 5-star), Canterbury Woods Pacific Grove (055303, 5-star), Carlsbad by the Sea (056496, 5-star), Claremont Manor (555085, 3-star).
All four sampled CA SNFs zero CMS fines.
Stable A/A- ratings across full window.
